question.text: In the BB&K (Bailard, Biehl & Kaiser) behavioral model, which personality type is characterized as confident and impetuous — someone who is willing to take risks but makes decisions without thorough analysis?

explanation.text: The Logic: Pages 258-259 of NISM Series X-A describe the BB&K model with two axes (confident-anxious and careful-impetuous) and identify the Adventurer as confident, impetuous, willing to take risks, and concentrated in their holdings. The Trap: The Individualist is confident and careful (independent and analytical). The Celebrity is anxious and impetuous (follows trends). The Straight Arrow sits in the centre of both axes — a balanced personality type. Only the Adventurer combines confidence with impetuousness. Note: The five BB&K types (Adventurer, Celebrity, Individualist, Guardian and Straight Arrow) are positioned on the two BB&K axes described on pages 258-259.
